newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ZARAGOZA SACK COACH VICTOR FERNANDEZ.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ZARAGOZA SACK COACH VICTOR FERNANDEZ.

text.p: Victor Fernandez was sacked by Zaragoza on Thursday less than 18 months after guiding the Spanish first division club to their greatest triumph.

Fernandez, who led Zaragoza to the Spanish Cup and European Cup Winners' Cup in consecutive seasons, will receive 250 million pesetas ($1.95 million) in lieu of the two seasons left on his contract, the club said.
Zaragoza struggled to reproduce their European form at home and have slumped to third from bottom in a season in which four teams face automatic relegation.
Fernandez's assistant Manuel Nieves is expected to take over for Sunday's league game against Hercules, who also sacked coach Ivan Brzic on Thursday.
